document.title: Používateľ

i18n.i18nString: Binds the case to the account. Set when the case is created.
The login name. It cannot be changed - it is the key for seed.json and for the tests as well.
Leave empty if the password is not to change.
Without ROLE_USER the person can log in but will see no views at all.
Pick one process, then its roles. Type to search.
A role is minted per net version. "All versions" is what you want almost every time.
Filled in once a process is picked. Type to search.

document.function: { def pu_meno, def pu_priezvisko, def pu_email -> def cele = (((pu_meno.value ?: "") as String).trim() + " " + ((pu_priezvisko.value ?: "") as String).trim()).trim() def mail = ((pu_email.value ?: "") as String).trim() if (!mail) return "Unlinked case" return (cele ? (cele + " · ") : "") + mail }

data.title: Verzia procesu
